shared_elements: low-relief carving of figural/object subject matter
radiating rosette-like motif (winged figure's feather fan / spoked wheel hub, and rosette border in B; floral rosettes on stylized tree in A)
band of repeated floral/petal ornament along an edge
finely incised repetitive detail (feather rows, beading, textile hatching)
justification: Both are low-relief compositions with meticulous repetitive incised detail and a border strip of repeated petal/rosette ornament, and both include radiating circular motifs, which suggests a broadly comparable decorative vocabulary. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A shows a standing winged anthropomorphic figure beside a stylized plant with rosette blossoms, while B shows a spoked chariot wheel with beaded rim below a hatched body and fringed elements, with no figure or plant in common relationship.
